$Comment: One face of the sample tree's choice node (Node Zc_Track_Example_Guard_Stance), in the Guard branch's second row, switched off like the rest of it: it opens once five points are spent in Guard (Requires on ziggfreedcommon:track_branch_spent), costs two points and adds five health. Taking it locks the other face, Zc_Track_Example_Tree_Rush, until it is undone or the track is respecced. A Node is one choice wherever its faces sit, on this track or another, so its id names the track it belongs to.
